I don’t know… I wouldn’t have described myself that way, no. I mean, I’ve always been careful. No, I wouldn’t say that. If anything, when I don’t sleep, I feel worn out the next day. Like I said, for months my sister’s appointments get moved around, bills come in wrong, someone says they’ll call me back and then they “forget.” And I know offices, I know how scheduling and paperwork works — I supervised people doing that kind of thing.
